conferenceCongressTransportation.faq.air: Yes. Conference and Congress Transportation supports organising airport arrivals as part of the confirmed event schedule.
conferenceCongressTransportation.faq.hot: Yes. The service supports hotel transfers and transportation between event locations. Exact points, times and sequence are confirmed within the transport plan.
conferenceCongressTransportation.faq.mul: Yes. Several vehicles can be organised within the same confirmed schedule when the event structure requires parallel or separate movements.
conferenceCongressTransportation.faq.ind: Yes. Individual transportation for executives and guests can be combined with group transportation within the same event, using appropriate vehicle roles.
conferenceCongressTransportation.faq.quo: Pricing is prepared as an individual quote based on the schedule, locations, passenger count, required vehicles and other confirmed transportation requirements.
conferenceCongressTransportation.faq.veh: You can state a preferred vehicle model. When a specific model is confirmed as part of the request, the arrangement is based on that confirmed model.
conferenceCongressTransportation.faq.con: No. The team checks availability, schedule, vehicles and request details, then confirms the arrangement manually.
